title: ayzek: request records and outputs of the held-out tests
description: Request records (dataset.json with SHA-256 of every fetched file), selection records, and the outputs of the three held-out tests and of the exploratory analyses of the ayzek earthquake detection and early-warning pipeline, with the static binary that ran the tests and the public KOERI datasets of the development replays. No test waveform is included.
